body: deploy/pi/ install/healthcheck/uninstall/run_job/jobs. Schedule IST: PEAD update wkdays 20:30; collect Mon-Sat 21:00; detect 21:30; PEAD finalize+score Sat; scoreboard daily 22:00; solvency Sun 06:00; git pull --ff-only Mon 07:00. SB_AUTO_APPLY=0 and FEIN_GIT_PUSH=0 by default. Untested on real Pi.
title: Pi deployment bundle v1: systemd/cron jobs, no inbound ports, no auto-push, scoreboard doesn't auto-apply memdb
